name: Release notes draft
summary: The product owner gets draft release notes for one shipped release, in words users recognize: what is new, changed, removed and fixed, the steps users must take, and the known limitations. Only what was supplied is described. The owner checks and publishes.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of product management work, and its own rules for prepared work: the owner's supplied sheets as the only authority, stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, every gap written as a question, nothing described that was not supplied, and nothing published until a person approves.
